Mobile/low-power capability bail-out for the star-field
Source src/experiments/star-field/engine/mobile.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

LOW_POWER_LIMITS

Low-end hardware ceilings — below these the GPU boot is a guaranteed freeze even on desktop UAs (software rasterizers, thin clients). CORES is a navigator.hardwareConcurrency floor, MEMORY_GB the deviceMemory floor; either signal alone marks the device weak.

isLowPowerMobile

Whether the runtime is a mobile-class or clearly low-power device — mobile UA token (Android/Mobile — iPhone/iPad already bail through isIOSDevice before this runs), or hardware hints below the LOW_POWER_LIMITS floor. Returns false on capable desktops and when navigator is unavailable.

  • @returns true when the engine should skip the GPU boot for the 2D fallback.
